meta.title: TypeMind — Learn typing through what you love
meta.description: A typing coach that adapts to your interests, your level and the way you type.

home.headline: Learn typing through what you love.
home.subhead: TypeMind finds the keys that slow you down and has you practice on texts you actually care about: programming, finance, science, sports, business emails…

points.title: Texts that make sense
points.body: No more random words: you practice on topics you choose, in your language.

points.title: Your real weak spots
points.body: Every key and letter pair is measured. Your next sessions target what holds you back.

points.title: Accuracy first
points.body: Net speed only counts correct characters. You improve without building bad habits.

home.keyboards: AZERTY, QWERTY, QWERTZ and Canadian layouts supported.

p: TypeMind is a typing-education service operated by [legal name, address]. Person in charge of the protection of personal information (Quebec Law 25): [name, email].
Account: email address, first name or nickname (optional), age range (14-17 or 18+). We do not ask for your date of birth.
Preferences: language, keyboard, interests, goals, time zone.
Learning: for each session, statistics (speed, accuracy, errors per key and letter pair, duration). The text you type is never sent to our servers.
Subscription: plan, status and Stripe customer id. Your card number is handled by Stripe only; we never see it.

To provide the service, adapt your exercises, show your progress, manage your subscription and keep the service secure (abuse prevention). We do not sell your data and do not run targeted advertising.
When you request a generated text, we send the AI provider [provider name] only the topic, language, your level and the keys to practice — never your name, email or identifier.

Supabase (database and authentication), Vercel (hosting), Stripe (payments), [AI provider]. Hosting region: [to be specified]. Transfers outside Quebec may occur; they are subject to a privacy impact assessment [to be carried out].
We only use cookies required to keep you signed in. Your browser's local storage keeps a finished session while offline until it is sent. No advertising or third-party analytics cookies.
Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Technical rate-limit records are deleted after 24 hours. Invoices remain with Stripe as required by accounting rules.

Access and portability: "Export my data" in your preferences. Correction: Preferences page. Deletion: "Delete my account" (immediate and permanent). For any other request or complaint: [email]. You may also contact the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
The service is for people aged 14 and over. An offer for younger learners, with parental consent, is not available yet.
TypeMind provides typing exercises, statistics and, depending on the plan, AI-generated texts. The service is provided "as is" and may change.
You must be at least 14, provide a valid email address and keep your password confidential. An account is personal.

The Free plan stays free. Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, renewed automatically, paid through Stripe. Prices are in Canadian dollars, taxes extra. You can cancel at any time: Pro access continues until the end of the paid period, without prorated refund [refund policy to be validated, including under Quebec's Consumer Protection Act].
No automation to fake statistics, no attempt to access other people's data, no abusive use of AI generation. We may suspend an account in case of abuse.
Generated texts are produced automatically and may contain inaccuracies. They are for practice only and are not advice (financial, medical or other).
